canonical_api_deployment_contract_candid: PR #258 — docs/operations/production-api-deployment-v1.md (not merged to main at snapshot time)

authority.registration_source: Registry RDAP for .com; registrar console remains the operational source of record for renewal and delegated nameservers.

zone_acceptance.registration_record: Registry RDAP record exists for afaghx.com, canonical name matches, expiry is in the future, no DNS-blocking EPP status is present, at least two registry nameservers are published.
zone_acceptance.delegation: NS and SOA records must resolve successfully through both independent public DNS-over-HTTPS providers.
zone_acceptance.propagation: Every required host must yield an A/AAAA address via both independent public resolvers; authoritative record targets must be taken from the actual provider configuration.

apex.record_strategy: PROVIDER_SPECIFIC_A_AAAA_OR_ALIAS_FLATTENING — determine from selected DNS/edge provider; no IP target guessed.
apex.https_acceptance: Valid HTTPS on apex, redirects to www.afaghx.com over HTTPS, final status 2xx.

required_record_contract.target_source: AFAGHX_DEPLOY_HOST from the protected production-platform GitHub Environment, populated only with the actual static public IPv4 assigned by the selected VPS provider.
required_record_contract.proxy_mode: DNS-only during initial provisioning because the candidate deployment contract verifies the public A record matches AFAGHX_DEPLOY_HOST.

api.ipv6_rule: Do not publish AAAA unless IPv6 is configured, routed and firewalled on the real host and a reviewed deployment contract supports it.
api.actual_host_ip: NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_REPOSITORY; must be read from the live provider console, never copied from an example.

prohibitions: Do not use the GitHub Pages project URL as an API target.
Do not copy documentation example IPs into public DNS.
Do not create DNS records before identifying authoritative DNS provider and actual hosting target.
Do not publish AAAA records for an IPv4-only runtime.
DNS resolution alone does not prove module implementation, AFX-CORE security, tenant isolation, RBAC or Production.
